svg.title: From zero to verified evidence
svg.desc: $ uv tool install ananke-plexus $ ananke init $ ananke spec converge --id PROJ-101 --title "Rate-limit the login API" --acceptance "Five failed logins in a minute lock the account" $ ananke graph build $ ananke graph impact --changed-file src/shop/users.py $ ananke verify $ ananke verify
svg.text: Install, initialise, specify, map the code, check the blast radius, verify. Real output from Ananke Plexus 0.3.5.

g.text: ananke spec converge --id PROJ-101 --title "Rate-limit the login API" \
--acceptance "Five failed logins in a minute lock the account"
# ruff BLOCKED: there is no tests/ folder yet. Add a test, then verify again.
One tool install gives you the ananke and apm commands.
Creates .ananke/ with config, the default policy and a
spec converge writes spec, plan, tasks and BMAD
graph build snapshots symbols and their relationships.
graph impact lists what a change touches before an agent
Gates run, and every result lands in a signed-off
